scope: Source review, mocked failure reproduction, read-only connected database observations

reviewCases.scenario: Save one player's partial history with identity, then save the full 24-player UID-only match without identity
Five collection runs with a persistent transient detail error
All selected ranker history requests fail
Save individual histories for eight participants of a 24-player match, then process its queue item

isolatedTests.interpretation: Passing review cases confirm current defects; they do not confirm a fix. All API and database writes in these cases were mocked.

limitations: Existing scheduled jobs could progress independently during read-only queries
Fewer than 24 participants is not evidence of truncation without comparison to the actual official match response
Stale run records do not prove whether the associated process is alive or why finalization was omitted
No exhausted retry items or duplicate nonempty UIDs were observed in the reviewed current data
No timeout log matches does not establish that historical snapshot performance problems are resolved

unverified: Official participant completeness for every stored match
